retrieved_resolution: There appears to be a security or trust issue between the UDM and other network components. If the UDM does not trust the credentials or certificates from other services (or those services do not trust the UDM) secure communication will fail. This often occurs due to an expired certificate or a certificate mismatch or misconfigured security settings. This results in TLS handshake failures or rejected connections. Verify the certificates and security configurations on the UDM and the peer entities (such as the AMF or AUSF). Ensure that the UDM certificates are valid and not expired and that they are recognized as trusted by the other components. Likewise confirm that the UDM trusts the certificates of its peers. If any certificate is expired or untrusted then install a valid certificate and adjust the trust settings accordingly. Once the security settings are corrected the UDM should be able to communicate securely with other network functions.

retrieved_resolution: There appears to be a security or trust issue between the UDM and other network components. If the UDM does not trust the credentials or certificates from other services (or those services do not trust the UDM) secure communication will fail. This often occurs due to an expired certificate or a certificate mismatch or misconfigured security settings. This results in TLS handshake failures or rejected connections. Verify the certificates and security configurations on the UDM and the peer entities (such as the AMF or AUSF). Ensure that the UDM certificates are valid and not expired and that they are recognized as trusted by the other components. Likewise confirm that the UDM trusts the certificates of its peers. If any certificate is expired or untrusted then install a valid certificate and adjust the trust settings accordingly. Once the security settings are corrected the UDM should be able to communicate securely with other network functions.
